questions.question_english: Which of the following statements correctly differentiates a Line-Item Budget from a Performance Budget?
options_english: A Line-Item Budget focuses on the purpose of the work, whereas a Performance Budget focuses on the things to be purchased
A Line-Item Budget focuses on inputs (what is bought), whereas a Performance Budget focuses on outputs (what is achieved)
A Line-Item Budget requires justifying all expenses from zero, whereas a Performance Budget uses historical data
A Line-Item Budget is used only for capital expenditure, whereas a Performance Budget is used for revenue expenditure
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is option D. A Line-Item Budget is primarily concerned with the categorization of expenditures, often focusing on capital expenditures, while a Performance Budget emphasizes the outcomes and effectiveness of spending, typically associated with revenue expenditures. This distinction is crucial for understanding how funds are allocated and the impact they have on educational outcomes.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। एक लाइन-आइटम बजट मुख्य रूप से व्यय की श्रेणीकरण पर केंद्रित होता है, जो अक्सर पूंजीगत व्यय पर ध्यान केंद्रित करता है, जबकि एक प्रदर्शन बजट व्यय के परिणामों और प्रभावशीलता पर जोर देता है, जो आमतौर पर राजस्व व्यय से संबंधित होता है। यह अंतर समझना महत्वपूर्ण है कि धन कैसे आवंटित किया जाता है और इसका शैक्षिक परिणामों पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ता है।
questions.topic: Leave and Leave Travel Concession LTC Rules
key_facts: Line-Item Budgets focus on categorizing expenditures.
Performance Budgets emphasize outcomes and effectiveness.
Printed answer key: (D) A Line-Item Budget is used only for capital expenditure, whereas a Performance Budget is used for revenue expenditure.

questions.question_english: What action should be taken if a Government servant applies for LTC advance but delays the booking of tickets?
options_english: The advance must be refunded if tickets are not booked within 10 days of drawal of the advance
A penal deduction of 5% is applied to the salary
The advance must be refunded if tickets are not booked within 30 days of drawal
The employee is demoted
questions.explanation_english: When a Government servant draws a Leave Travel Concession advance but fails to book passenger tickets within thirty days of drawal, the advance must be refunded immediately. Non-utilization of the drawn amount within thirty days requires full repayment to prevent the imposition of statutory penal interest charges.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। जब एक सरकारी कर्मचारी एलटीसी अग्रिम निकालता है लेकिन तीस दिनों के भीतर यात्री टिकटों की बुकिंग नहीं करता है, तो अग्रिम को तुरंत वापस करना होगा। तीस दिनों के भीतर निकाली गई राशि का उपयोग न करने पर पूर्ण पुनर्भुगतान आवश्यक है ताकि वैधानिक दंडात्मक ब्याज शुल्क से बचा जा सके।
questions.topic: Leave and Leave Travel Concession LTC Rules
key_facts: Government servants must book tickets within 30 days of drawing LTC advance.
Failure to book tickets results in mandatory refund of the advance.
Printed answer key: (C) The advance must be refunded if tickets are not booked within 30 days of drawal.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following relatives of a Central Government employee:
I. Unmarried dependent sister
II. Dependent widowed sister
III. Dependent divorced sister
IV. Married dependent sister
Which of the above relatives are explicitly included in the definition of 'Family' for LTC purposes?
options_english: I and II only
I, II, and III only
II and IV only
I, II, III, and IV
questions.explanation_english: The definition of family under Leave Travel Concession rules includes unmarried dependent sisters, widowed dependent sisters, and divorced dependent sisters, provided they are wholly dependent on the employee and reside together or at the Home Town. Married sisters are excluded from the family definition regardless of their financial status or place of residence.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। यात्रा भत्ते के नियमों के तहत परिवार की परिभाषा में अविवाहित आश्रित बहनें, विधवा आश्रित बहनें, और तलाकशुदा आश्रित बहनें शामिल हैं, बशर्ते वे कर्मचारी पर पूरी तरह से निर्भर हों और एक साथ या गृह नगर में निवास करें। विवाहित बहनें परिवार की परिभाषा से बाहर हैं, चाहे उनकी वित्तीय स्थिति या निवास स्थान कुछ भी हो।
questions.topic: Leave and Leave Travel Concession LTC Rules
key_facts: Family definition includes unmarried, widowed, and divorced dependent sisters.
Married sisters are excluded from the definition.
Printed answer key: (B) I, II, and III only

One Home Town LTC and one Anywhere in India LTC alternately taken every year

questions.question_english: Which of the following periods of leave does NOT count towards the minimum continuous service required for LTC eligibility?
options_english: Extraordinary Leave without medical certificate and not for higher studies
Earned Leave granted for personal reasons or vacation
Maternity Leave granted to female employees for child care
Extraordinary Leave granted on account of certified illness
questions.explanation_english: Extraordinary Leave granted without a medical certificate and not for pursuing higher studies does not count towards the continuous service requirement for Leave Travel Concession eligibility. All regular leave types, including Earned Leave, Maternity Leave, and Extraordinary Leave taken on medical grounds, are treated as valid unbroken service for calculating the required eligibility period under government regulations.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। असाधारण अवकाश जो चिकित्सा प्रमाण पत्र के बिना और उच्च अध्ययन के लिए नहीं दिया गया है, वह LTC पात्रता के लिए निरंतर सेवा की आवश्यकता में नहीं गिना जाता। सभी नियमित अवकाश प्रकार, जिसमें अर्जित अवकाश, मातृत्व अवकाश, और चिकित्सा कारणों से लिया गया असाधारण अवकाश शामिल हैं, उन्हें सरकारी नियमों के तहत आवश्यक पात्रता अवधि की गणना के लिए वैध निरंतर सेवा के रूप में माना जाता है।

questions.question_english: A Government servant in Pay Level 7, who is entitled only to train travel, chooses to travel by air to their Home Town. They purchase the air ticket directly from the airline’s counter. What is the correct administrative action by the DDO?
options_english: Reject the claim entirely because the employee traveled by an unentitled air mode
Reimburse the actual airfare paid as a special administrative exception
Forward the claim to the higher authority for obtaining special sanction
Restrict reimbursement to the entitled train class fare by shortest route
questions.explanation_english: An employee in Pay Level 7 who is entitled only to train travel but travels by air to their Home Town without specific authorization receives restricted reimbursement. The Drawing and Disbursing Officer must restrict the financial claim to the entitled train class fare along the shortest direct rail route, rejecting the excess airfare.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। एक कर्मचारी जो वेतन स्तर 7 में है और जिसे केवल ट्रेन यात्रा का अधिकार है, यदि बिना विशेष अनुमति के अपने गृह नगर के लिए हवाई यात्रा करता है, तो उसे सीमित पुनर्भुगतान प्राप्त होता है। ड्राइंग और डिस्बर्सिंग अधिकारी को वित्तीय दावे को संक्षिप्त मार्ग द्वारा पात्र ट्रेन श्रेणी के किराए तक सीमित करना चाहिए, अतिरिक्त हवाई किराए को अस्वीकार करते हुए।

questions.question_english: A Principal notices that while the school strictly adhered to its Line-Item budget allocations for teacher training and library books, the overall student pass percentage declined. The SMC questions the utility of the expenditure. What does this scenario primarily highlight about the Line-Item budget?
options_english: It tracks input compliance but not qualitative educational outcomes
It systematically encourages unauthorized diversion of funds across different departmental expenditure heads
It automatically results in significant outcomes
It is used only for capital expenditure
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is option C. This scenario highlights that while a Line-Item Budget ensures compliance with allocated funds for specific inputs, it does not necessarily correlate with the quality of educational outcomes. The focus on inputs rather than results can lead to a disconnect between spending and actual student performance, emphasizing the need for a more outcome-oriented budgeting approach.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। यह परिदृश्य यह उजागर करता है कि जबकि एक लाइन-आइटम बजट विशिष्ट इनपुट के लिए आवंटित धन के अनुपालन को सुनिश्चित करता है, यह शैक्षिक परिणामों की गुणवत्ता के साथ अनिवार्य रूप से संबंधित नहीं होता है। परिणामों के बजाय इनपुट पर ध्यान केंद्रित करने से व्यय और वास्तविक छात्र प्रदर्शन के बीच एक disconnect उत्पन्न हो सकता है, जो एक अधिक परिणाम-उन्मुख बजटिंग दृष्टिकोण की आवश्यकता को उजागर करता है।

key_facts: Line-Item Budgets ensure compliance with allocated funds.
They may not correlate with quality educational outcomes.
Printed answer key: (C) It automatically results in significant outcomes.
